title: Identification of m5C-Related gene diagnostic biomarkers for sepsis: a machine learning study
summary: Machine-learning selection identifies three m5C-related sepsis biomarkers with diagnostic performance in test and validation sets (AUC >0.7). This is a specific disease classification result, limited to retrospective datasets.
